newsitem.title: HONG KONG: United Phosphorus loan raised to $18 mln.
newsitem.headline: United Phosphorus loan raised to $18 mln.

text.p: United Phosphorus Ltd's term loan facility has been increased to US$18 million from US$15 million due to oversubscription, the arrangers said.

The loan carries a maturity of five years and has an average life of four years. It pays a margin of 80 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate. With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 85 basis points.
Proceeds will be used for financing the borrower's project related expenditure and working capital.
Arrangers, with US$2.75 million each, are Credit Lyonnais and Union Bank of Switzerland.
Lead managers, with US$2.5 million each, are Development Bank of Singapore, Dresdner (South East Asia) and Rabobank Singapore branch.
Co-lead managers are SBI European Bank, with US$2 million, and Indian Bank and Sakura Bank, with US$1.5 million each.
Signing will be held in Bombay during the last week of December.
